atoms.name: Representation and cost
atoms.one_line: Lists: Θ(n+m). Matrix: Θ(n²) for a full traversal.

atoms.name: BFS: queue and levels
atoms.one_line: Queue gives levels; levels are shortest distances in unweighted graphs.

atoms.name: DFS: stack, times, edge types
atoms.one_line: Discovery and finish times; tree, back, forward, cross edges.

atoms.name: Valid and counted orders
atoms.one_line: Replay the queue or path; count by multiplying batch factorials.

atoms.name: Tree properties
atoms.one_line: BFS levels differ by ≤1; undirected DFS has no cross edges; tree height ≥ diameter/2.

atoms.name: Components
atoms.one_line: One tree per component; forest edges = n - c.

atoms.name: DAGs and topological order
atoms.one_line: Back edge means cycle; decreasing finish time gives a topological order.

atoms.name: Articulation points
atoms.one_line: Root with ≥2 children; non-root with a child lacking an escape back edge.

atoms.name: Strongly connected components
atoms.one_line: Mutual reachability; condensation is a DAG; same SCCs in G and its reverse.
